summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K announcing that its subsidiary signed a colocation lease agreement for an AI data center site in Tydal, Norway. The lease is not yet effective; it remains subject to conditions precedent, including completion of external customer and supplier arrangements by the counterparty. No financial terms, price, premium, or strategic event such as M&A, restructuring, or capital return are disclosed. The filing is purely an operational business development announcement with no special-situation characteristics.
